chunks: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, saying: Al-Husayn ibn Ishaq al-Tajir narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Mihran narrated to us, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Husayn ibn Ilwan, from Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir, from Badr ibn Abdullah, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) saying:
The best of deputies, the master of martyrs, and the nearest of people in station to the prophets will enter upon you from this door. Then Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) entered.

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said: And why should I not say this, O Aba al-Hasan, when you are the keeper of my Pond, the fulfiller of my covenant, and the one who will discharge my debts on my behalf.

key_terms.الشُّهَدَاءِ: The martyrs, those who bear witness to truth and sacrifice their lives for it
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: The deputies or successors, referring to the divinely appointed successors of the prophets
key_terms.حَوْضِي: My Pond, referring to the Pond of Kawthar which the Prophet will preside over on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.ذِمَّتِي: My covenant or obligation, the religious and social responsibilities of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali ibn Abi Talib being the best of deputies and the keeper of his Pond?
ai.summary: In this hadith narrated by the companion Anas ibn Malik through a chain going back to Shaykh al-Saduq, the Prophet Muhammad (s) foretold that the best of successors, the master of martyrs, and the person nearest in rank to the prophets would enter through a specific door. When Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) entered, the Prophet confirmed his statement, explaining that Ali is the keeper of his Pond (al-Kawthar), the fulfiller of his covenant, and the discharger of his debts. This hadith was narrated in the context of gatherings where the Prophet publicly declared Ali's unique virtues before the companions.
